crossRefs.note: Since the world began it has never been heard of that anyone opened the eyes of someone born blind.

translations.web: As he passed by, he saw a man blind from birth.
translations.bsb: Now as Jesus was passing by, He saw a man blind from birth,
translations.kjv: And as Jesus passed by, he saw a man which was blind from his birth.
translations.asv: And as he passed by, he saw a man blind from his birth.
